transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with extreme mood swings lately. For about four months, I felt incredibly energetic, hyperactive, and easily irritated, but over the last two months, I've crashed into a deep depression where I feel completely empty and sad. It has just been exhausting trying to deal with these highs and lows.

During that four-month high period, did you ever need much less sleep, do risky or impulsive things, or feel so out of control that you were hospitalized or had major problems at work, school, or with other people?

No, I didn't really experience a decreased need for sleep or do anything risky or impulsive during that time. I also wasn't hospitalized, and I managed to avoid any major trouble at work or with my family. It was more about feeling constantly restless, hyperactive, and easily irritated.
During that four-month high period, did you feel unusually confident or important, or more talkative with racing thoughts compared with your usual self?

During those four months, I felt incredibly important and truly believed I possessed special, extraordinary abilities and powers. I don't really recall having racing thoughts or being unusually talkative, but I definitely felt like I was destined for something great.

Have you ever had these beliefs about having special powers, or heard or seen things others couldn’t, during times when you were not in a high or depressed mood? If so, did that last for at least two weeks?

No, those experiences only happened during the times when I was feeling really high and energetic. When my mood was normal or when I felt down, I didn't experience any of those special beliefs or see and hear things that weren't there.
When you believed you had special powers during that high period, did you actually hear voices or see things others could not, or was it only a very strong belief?

Yes, alongside my strong belief in having special powers, I actually heard voices and saw things that others couldn't. Those experiences of hearing and seeing things only happened during that high period. Once that energetic phase ended, they stopped completely.
During that high period, besides feeling energetic and irritable, did you have a persistently elevated or euphoric mood most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, absolutely. During those four months, I felt an incredibly high, euphoric mood almost every day, full of this unmotivated happiness and vitality. It felt like I was constantly on top of the world for no particular reason.

During that four-month high period, were you still able to function normally day to day, or did the symptoms become severe enough to clearly impair your work, relationships, judgment, or need emergency care?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't really thought about how to measure that. I just know that during those months, everything felt incredibly chaotic and completely out of control.
During that high period, did the voices or visions make it hard for you to work, manage daily life, or stay safe, even if you weren’t hospitalized?

I'm not really sure if they directly put my safety or work at risk, as everything felt so chaotic back then. I just know that hearing and seeing those things was incredibly overwhelming and made it very hard to focus on normal daily tasks. It is difficult to separate how much of the trouble was from the voices versus just feeling so sped up.
Just to be clear, was there ever a time for at least two weeks when you were not feeling high or depressed but still hearing voices or seeing things that others could not?
No, I have never experienced hearing voices or seeing things during a period when my mood was normal. Those unusual experiences only happened when I was feeling extremely high and full of energy.
